kashika: तादर्थ्य इति निवृत्तम्। देवशब्दात् स्वार्थे तल् प्रत्ययो भवति। देव एव देवता॥
kashikaEnglish: तल् after देव without sense-change: देवता = देवः. Always feminine.
englishFull:
देवस्य च तल् — तल् comes after देव without change of sense.

देवता = देवः — deity

This word is always feminine (a svārthika derivative doesn't always follow the gender of its primitive).
